text:
Posted by Hazel Jackson 09 pm Sentiment for Corillian Corp (NASDAQ:CORI)
Corillian Corp (NASDAQ:CORI) institutional sentiment increased to 3.91 in Q2 2018 . Its up 2.59, from 1.32 in 2018Q1. The ratio improved, as 43 investment professionals increased or started new stock positions, while 11 cut down and sold stakes in Corillian Corp. The investment professionals in our partner’s database now hold: 69.99 million shares, up from 32.85 million shares in 2018Q1. Also, the number of investment professionals holding Corillian Corp in their top 10 stock positions decreased from 3 to 2 for a decrease of 1. Sold All: 3 Reduced: 8 Increased: 30 New Position: 13.
Corium International, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development, manufacture, and commercialization of specialty pharmaceutical products in transdermal and transmucosal delivery systems. The company has market cap of $463.05 million. It offers Clonidine Transdermal Delivery System , a treatment for hypertension; Fentanyl TDS, a treatment for the management of chronic pain, including cancer-related pain; and Crest Whitestrips for teeth whitening. It currently has negative earnings. The companyÂ’s products under pipeline comprise Twirla, a combination hormonal contraceptive patch, which has completed Phase III clinical trial to deliver ethinyl estradiol and levonorgestrel hormones; MicroCor hPTH(1-34), a transdermal system that has completed Phase 1 and Phase II a clinical trial for the treatment of severe osteoporosis; and Donepezil and Memantine transdermal systems, which completed Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
It closed at $12.68 lastly. It is up 4.92% since December 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.54% the S&P500.
Broadfin Capital Llc holds 4.54% of its portfolio in Corium International, Inc. for 3.60 million shares. Awm Investment Company Inc. owns 2.29 million shares or 3.07% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Opaleye Management Inc. has 1.66% invested in the company for 800,000 shares. The Georgia-based Emory University has invested 1.46% in the stock.
